agentic-kit · Governance WASM Demo

All three functions run inside the browser via a single Go → WASM compilation of the governance foundations. The PoW solver burns the client's CPU — not the server's — making abuse cost the attacker work.

Loading WASM…

1. Proof-of-Work Solver

Paste a Challenge JSON issued by your server (fields: Nonce, Bits, ExpiresAt, MAC). The challenge is HMAC-signed server-side — treat it as opaque and return it verbatim, including the MAC. Click Solve — the browser will brute-force a solution. 



  
  
2. Proof-of-Work Pre-check (client-side only)

  

    After solving above, click Check to confirm the solution meets the
    challenge's difficulty and the challenge has not expired — a local
    sanity check before submitting. Authoritative verification
    happens server-side only: the server authenticates the
    challenge's HMAC signature, enforces the difficulty floor and expiry,
    and rejects replays. The HMAC secret never leaves the server, so a
    browser cannot (and must not) verify on its behalf.
  

  
  


  
  
3. Edge Prefilter

  

    A zero-cost length / empty check an edge worker runs before
    forwarding to origin — no model call required.
